approach: Extend _sanitize_text() to escape Unicode bidirectional override characters
summary: Added sanitization for Unicode bidirectional override characters that enable display spoofing attacks. The fix escapes U+202A-U+202E (bidi formatting), U+2066-U+2069 (bidi isolate controls), U+200E-U+200F (direction marks), and U+FEFF (BOM) using \uNNNN escape sequences.
risks: Normal text with legitimate direction marks (e.g., multilingual content) will show escaped characters instead of proper direction markers
